text: Milk is run through a membrane that keeps protein and calcium and lets sugar and water pass, then lactase breaks down the lactose that is left. No membrane type or temperature is published.

steps.note: The milk sugar that is left is broken down, which makes the milk lactose-free.
The fat is put back into the skim milk, to make 1 %, 2 % or whole milk.
